blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Langley total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Willoughby Heights fell from 119 in June to 100 in September, and 74 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 22.3% of Langley’s 449 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in Willoughby Heights?
Willoughby Heights also had 369 condos and townhomes listed and 70 sold in September, against 100 houses listed. The Willoughby Heights condos and townhomes page has those figures.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Willoughby Heights?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 100 houses listed in Willoughby Heights. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Willoughby Heights a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses in Willoughby Heights had a sales ratio of 13%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Willoughby Heights from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 74 houses sold in Willoughby Heights over those 4 months, out of 298 in all of Langley.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Willoughby Heights?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.
